tagline.en: NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2 — a world-model foundation for image-to-video and Video2World generation, in 2B and 14B sizes.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2——用于图生视频与 Video2World 生成的世界模型基座,提供 2B 与 14B 两种规模。

en: Cosmos Predict 2 is part of NVIDIA's Cosmos family of world foundation models. It predicts future video from an image or an existing clip — a Video2World setup — aimed at physical-AI and simulation use cases where you want a model that anticipates how a scene evolves.

It comes in two sizes, a 2B and a 14B Video2World checkpoint, both released under the NVIDIA Open Model License (checkpoint access is gated). Internally it pairs a T5 text conditioner with a diffusion denoiser and a rectified-flow scheduler, decoding through a Wan video codec.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the shared native diffusion pipeline — provide an image or video plus a prompt, pick the 2B or 14B checkpoint, and it generates the predicted world video.
zh: Cosmos Predict 2 属于 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos 世界基础模型家族。它从一张图像或一段已有视频预测未来画面——即 Video2World 设定——面向物理 AI 与仿真场景,适合需要模型预判场景如何演变的用途。
它提供 2B 与 14B 两个 Video2World checkpoint,均以 NVIDIA Open Model License 发布(checkpoint 需授权访问)。其内部由 T5 文本条件器、扩散去噪器与 rectified-flow 调度器组合而成,并通过 Wan 视频编解码器解码。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过统一的原生扩散 pipeline 运行:给出一张图像或一段视频加上提示词,选择 2B 或 14B checkpoint,它便生成预测的世界视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want a world model that predicts video forward from an image or clip (Video2World) for physical-AI and simulation work, and want to choose between a lighter 2B and a higher-fidelity 14B.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个从图像或片段向前预测视频的世界模型(Video2World),用于物理 AI 与仿真,并希望在更轻的 2B 与更高保真的 14B 之间选择时。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are gated under the NVIDIA Open Model License, so you need to request and stage access. The 14B needs substantially more hardware than the 2B.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 在 NVIDIA Open Model License 下需授权访问,使用前需申请并准备好权限。14B 所需硬件明显高于 2B。
